provenance.active_file_metadata_limit: Concurrent writers can change live DB/WAL/SHM. mode=ro/query_only and total_changes describe this reader only.
provenance.hash_function_body_handling: hash only; no JSON parsing/retention/printing; no whole model request/response hash or body query
provenance.opaque_hash_representation: SHA256 of exact UTF8 SQL TEXT projection; original action TEXT or json_extract JSON text. NULL remains NULL.
provenance.query:
SELECT
  a.decision_index,
  safe_token(json_extract(a.action,'$.kind')) AS selected_kind,
  safe_token(json_extract(a.action,'$.tool')) AS selected_tool,
  opaque_sha256(a.action) AS action_text_sha256,
  json_type(a.action,'$.arguments') AS arguments_json_type,
  CASE WHEN json_extract(a.action,'$.kind')='tool' THEN opaque_sha256(json_extract(a.action,'$.arguments')) ELSE NULL END AS arguments_json_text_sha256,
  a.result IS NULL AS result_missing,
  a.credit IS NULL AS credit_is_null,
  safe_token(json_extract(a.result,'$.status')) AS outcome_status,
  safe_reference(json_extract(a.result,'$.operation_ref')) AS operation_ref,
  n.call_index AS next_call_index,
  n.purpose AS next_call_purpose,
  CASE WHEN n.call_index IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE n.response IS NULL END AS next_response_missing,
  safe_token(json_extract(n.request,'$.version')) AS next_request_version,
  safe_token(json_extract(n.request,'$.context.last_local_outcome.status')) AS next_raw_last_outcome_status,
  safe_reference(json_extract(n.request,'$.context.last_local_outcome.operation_ref')) AS next_raw_last_outcome_operation_ref,
  safe_token(json_extract(n.request,'$.model_presentation.context.last_local_outcome.status')) AS next_model_last_outcome_status,
  safe_reference(json_extract(n.request,'$.model_presentation.context.last_local_outcome.operation_ref')) AS next_model_last_outcome_operation_ref,
  json_type(n.request,'$.model_presentation') AS next_model_presentation_type,
  json_type(json_extract(a.result,'$.feedback')) AS outcome_feedback_json_type,
  opaque_sha256(json_extract(a.result,'$.feedback')) AS outcome_feedback_sha256,
  safe_token(json_extract(json_extract(a.result,'$.feedback'),'$.category')) AS outcome_feedback_category,
  safe_token(json_extract(json_extract(a.result,'$.feedback'),'$.code')) AS outcome_feedback_code,
  safe_token(json_extract(json_extract(a.result,'$.feedback'),'$.phase')) AS outcome_feedback_phase,
  safe_token(json_extract(json_extract(a.result,'$.feedback'),'$.exception_type')) AS outcome_feedback_exception_type,
  safe_token(json_extract(json_extract(a.result,'$.feedback'),'$.native_code')) AS outcome_feedback_native_code,
  safe_reference(json_extract(json_extract(a.result,'$.feedback'),'$.diagnostic_ref')) AS outcome_feedback_diagnostic_ref,
  safe_token(json_extract(json_extract(a.result,'$.feedback'),'$.detail.code')) AS outcome_feedback_detail_code,
  safe_token(json_extract(json_extract(a.result,'$.feedback'),'$.cause.code')) AS outcome_feedback_cause_code,
  safe_token(json_extract(json_extract(a.result,'$.feedback'),'$.native.statistics_export.code')) AS outcome_feedback_native_statistics_code,
  json_type(json_extract(a.result,'$.feedback'),'$.detail') AS outcome_feedback_detail_type,
  json_type(json_extract(n.request,'$.context.feedback')) AS next_raw_feedback_json_type,
  opaque_sha256(json_extract(n.request,'$.context.feedback')) AS next_raw_feedback_sha256,
  safe_token(json_extract(json_extract(n.request,'$.context.feedback'),'$.category')) AS next_raw_feedback_category,
  safe_token(json_extract(json_extract(n.request,'$.context.feedback'),'$.code')) AS next_raw_feedback_code,
  safe_token(json_extract(json_extract(n.request,'$.context.feedback'),'$.phase')) AS next_raw_feedback_phase,
  safe_token(json_extract(json_extract(n.request,'$.context.feedback'),'$.exception_type')) AS next_raw_feedback_exception_type,
  safe_token(json_extract(json_extract(n.request,'$.context.feedback'),'$.native_code')) AS next_raw_feedback_native_code,
  safe_reference(json_extract(json_extract(n.request,'$.context.feedback'),'$.diagnostic_ref')) AS next_raw_feedback_diagnostic_ref,
  safe_token(json_extract(json_extract(n.request,'$.context.feedback'),'$.detail.code')) AS next_raw_feedback_detail_code,
  safe_token(json_extract(json_extract(n.request,'$.context.feedback'),'$.cause.code')) AS next_raw_feedback_cause_code,
  safe_token(json_extract(json_extract(n.request,'$.context.feedback'),'$.native.statistics_export.code')) AS next_raw_feedback_native_statistics_code,
  json_type(json_extract(n.request,'$.context.feedback'),'$.detail') AS next_raw_feedback_detail_type,
  json_type(json_extract(n.request,'$.model_presentation.context.feedback')) AS next_model_feedback_json_type,
  opaque_sha256(json_extract(n.request,'$.model_presentation.context.feedback')) AS next_model_feedback_sha256,
  safe_token(json_extract(json_extract(n.request,'$.model_presentation.context.feedback'),'$.category')) AS next_model_feedback_category,
  safe_token(json_extract(json_extract(n.request,'$.model_presentation.context.feedback'),'$.code')) AS next_model_feedback_code,
  safe_token(json_extract(json_extract(n.request,'$.model_presentation.context.feedback'),'$.phase')) AS next_model_feedback_phase,
  safe_token(json_extract(json_extract(n.request,'$.model_presentation.context.feedback'),'$.exception_type')) AS next_model_feedback_exception_type,
  safe_token(json_extract(json_extract(n.request,'$.model_presentation.context.feedback'),'$.native_code')) AS next_model_feedback_native_code,
  safe_reference(json_extract(json_extract(n.request,'$.model_presentation.context.feedback'),'$.diagnostic_ref')) AS next_model_feedback_diagnostic_ref,
  safe_token(json_extract(json_extract(n.request,'$.model_presentation.context.feedback'),'$.detail.code')) AS next_model_feedback_detail_code,
  safe_token(json_extract(json_extract(n.request,'$.model_presentation.context.feedback'),'$.cause.code')) AS next_model_feedback_cause_code,
  safe_token(json_extract(json_extract(n.request,'$.model_presentation.context.feedback'),'$.native.statistics_export.code')) AS next_model_feedback_native_statistics_code,
  json_type(json_extract(n.request,'$.model_presentation.context.feedback'),'$.detail') AS next_model_feedback_detail_type,
  json_type(json_extract(n.request,'$.context.last_local_outcome.feedback')) AS next_raw_last_feedback_json_type,
  opaque_sha256(json_extract(n.request,'$.context.last_local_outcome.feedback')) AS next_raw_last_feedback_sha256,
  safe_token(json_extract(json_extract(n.request,'$.context.last_local_outcome.feedback'),'$.category')) AS next_raw_last_feedback_category,
  safe_token(json_extract(json_extract(n.request,'$.context.last_local_outcome.feedback'),'$.code')) AS next_raw_last_feedback_code,
  safe_token(json_extract(json_extract(n.request,'$.context.last_local_outcome.feedback'),'$.phase')) AS next_raw_last_feedback_phase,
  safe_token(json_extract(json_extract(n.request,'$.context.last_local_outcome.feedback'),'$.exception_type')) AS next_raw_last_feedback_exception_type,
  safe_token(json_extract(json_extract(n.request,'$.context.last_local_outcome.feedback'),'$.native_code')) AS next_raw_last_feedback_native_code,
  safe_reference(json_extract(json_extract(n.request,'$.context.last_local_outcome.feedback'),'$.diagnostic_ref')) AS next_raw_last_feedback_diagnostic_ref,
  safe_token(json_extract(json_extract(n.request,'$.context.last_local_outcome.feedback'),'$.detail.code')) AS next_raw_last_feedback_detail_code,
  safe_token(json_extract(json_extract(n.request,'$.context.last_local_outcome.feedback'),'$.cause.code')) AS next_raw_last_feedback_cause_code,
  safe_token(json_extract(json_extract(n.request,'$.context.last_local_outcome.feedback'),'$.native.statistics_export.code')) AS next_raw_last_feedback_native_statistics_code,
  json_type(json_extract(n.request,'$.context.last_local_outcome.feedback'),'$.detail') AS next_raw_last_feedback_detail_type,
  json_type(json_extract(n.request,'$.model_presentation.context.last_local_outcome.feedback')) AS next_model_last_feedback_json_type,
  opaque_sha256(json_extract(n.request,'$.model_presentation.context.last_local_outcome.feedback')) AS next_model_last_feedback_sha256,
  safe_token(json_extract(json_extract(n.request,'$.model_presentation.context.last_local_outcome.feedback'),'$.category')) AS next_model_last_feedback_category,
  safe_token(json_extract(json_extract(n.request,'$.model_presentation.context.last_local_outcome.feedback'),'$.code')) AS next_model_last_feedback_code,
  safe_token(json_extract(json_extract(n.request,'$.model_presentation.context.last_local_outcome.feedback'),'$.phase')) AS next_model_last_feedback_phase,
  safe_token(json_extract(json_extract(n.request,'$.model_presentation.context.last_local_outcome.feedback'),'$.exception_type')) AS next_model_last_feedback_exception_type,
  safe_token(json_extract(json_extract(n.request,'$.model_presentation.context.last_local_outcome.feedback'),'$.native_code')) AS next_model_last_feedback_native_code,
  safe_reference(json_extract(json_extract(n.request,'$.model_presentation.context.last_local_outcome.feedback'),'$.diagnostic_ref')) AS next_model_last_feedback_diagnostic_ref,
  safe_token(json_extract(json_extract(n.request,'$.model_presentation.context.last_local_outcome.feedback'),'$.detail.code')) AS next_model_last_feedback_detail_code,
  safe_token(json_extract(json_extract(n.request,'$.model_presentation.context.last_local_outcome.feedback'),'$.cause.code')) AS next_model_last_feedback_cause_code,
  safe_token(json_extract(json_extract(n.request,'$.model_presentation.context.last_local_outcome.feedback'),'$.native.statistics_export.code')) AS next_model_last_feedback_native_statistics_code,
  json_type(json_extract(n.request,'$.model_presentation.context.last_local_outcome.feedback'),'$.detail') AS next_model_last_feedback_detail_type
FROM runtime_actions a
LEFT JOIN runtime_model_calls n
  ON n.run_id=a.run_id AND n.episode_id=a.episode_id
 AND n.call_index=a.decision_index+1 AND n.call_index<=46
WHERE a.run_id=? AND a.episode_id=? AND a.decision_index BETWEEN 0 AND 45
ORDER BY a.decision_index
